comparison.objective: Restock two amenity trays exactly to par while retaining surplus stock.
comparison.physical_skill: Inventory-sensitive pick-and-place, cross-arm staging, and regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Each tray has exactly one flat soap and one upright shampoo; spare remains on cart and nothing is misplaced.
comparison.reason: Tests exact-count restocking and handoff staging rather than fastener manipulation and iterative dynamic tuning.
